title: fix(console): a session answered "not shown" sends no first-run checklist reads on later opens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8JtfL3chjK7xVPpJ6UJRz9z)_

Fixes #37182

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 做了什么：看不到「开始使用」清单的会话（普通成员；控制面上的普通组织所有者），第一次被服务端答成「不显示」后，本机记住这个答案（按组织、用户、权限集合，24 小时）；之后打开控制台不再多发 `GET /api/settings`。
- 管理员不受影响：每次照旧读取并显示清单。权限变了、换人或换组织、过期、读取失败，都会重新读。
- 结果：cloud 控制面计费页的预热打开回到 25 次请求；下一轮 cloud 抄版本把预算从 26 改回 25。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

- `firstRunChecklistLogic.ts`: a device record of the server's "not shown" answer, `os:first-run-checklist-not-shown:<orgId>:<userId>`, holding the capability list it was read for and when (`notShownRecordKey`, `wasAnsweredNotShown`, `markAnsweredNotShown`, `NOT_SHOWN_RECORD_TTL_MS` = one day). It fails toward reading again: unreadable storage, a record that does not parse, a different capability set, an expired record, or one dated in the future all read.
- `firstRunChecklistState.tsx`: the provider checks the record before scheduling its reads and asks nothing while it stands; when `readChecklistSettings` answers `null` (the server's answer that this session may not write `localization`), it writes the record. A read that throws writes nothing. An administrator's path is untouched.

## Why

Since #36791 the provider is mounted above every app route and, after the first paint, sends `GET /api/settings` for every session whose `systemPermissions` is non-empty. For a session never shown the checklist that request buys nothing, on every console open. The cloud pin round cloud#4982 (PR cloud#4983) measured it as the 26th call of the control plane's `page/pricing` warm open, budget 25.

Why a remembered answer and not a capability check before the request: the session that red the budget, an ordinary organization owner on the control plane, holds `setup.write`; that plane re-registers `localization` with `writePermission: manage_platform_settings` (cloud `control-plane-settings.ts`). Which permission a deployment's manifest asks is known only once the list answers, and naming one in the console would be a second copy of the manifest's declaration that drifts on the next deployment that changes it. The first open on a device still pays the one read; every later open within the day does not.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/firstRunChecklistLogic.test.ts apps/console/src/pages/settings/__tests__/FirstRunChecklist.test.tsx` (from `ui/`): 119 passed.
- New provider pins (`a session answered "not shown" asks nothing again on this device`): a member reads once then never; an owner holding `setup.write` where `localization` asks `manage_platform_settings` reads once across three opens; an administrator reads and is shown it on every open; a member made administrator reads again at once; a failed list read records nothing; another user in the same browser reads for themself. New logic pins cover the key, capability-set match, the one-day bound, a future-dated record, unreadable storage and unparseable records.
- Ablation: with `firstRunChecklistState.tsx` reverted to `main`, the member and control-plane-owner pins fail (2 failed, 88 passed in that file); the other four pass on both, as preservation pins.
- `eslint` on the four touched files: 0 errors (2 pre-existing `react-refresh/only-export-components` warnings on `firstRunChecklistState.tsx`).
- Not run locally: the cloud `console-boots` budget. The next cloud pin round reads it and moves `page/pricing` `maxCalls` back to 25, with the reading recorded on cloud#2914.

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.

- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
